title: Direct Interaction with a Reach-through Volumetric Display that uses an Elastic Diffuser
abstract: Volumetric displays render true 3D graphics without forcing users to wear headsets or glasses. However, the optical diffusers that volumetric displays employ are rigid and thus do not allow for direct interaction. We showcase FlexiVol, a volumetric display that employs elastic diffusers, allowing users to reach inside the display volume and have direct interaction with true-3D content. We plan to demo two playful come-and-interact applications involving FlexiVol, enabling participants to explore its interaction design space, without having to wear any devices. Participants will be able to navigate, select, manipulate, or edit true-3D content, spatially aligned with their bare hands.
